method: Twelve names across eight sectors, conviction-weighted toward multi-sleeve strength: NVDA 13.0% (growth 9.7 / quality 9.6 / momentum 8.2, composite 8.12 and the cohort's joint-best entry haircut 1.15), then V 11.5% and JPM 10.5% as the two tight-range compounders (0.25 and 0.247 range/price) that can carry size without vol drag. The incumbent book is the null hypothesis and was preserved wherever verify supported it — MSFT 9.34%→8.5%, SHEL 8.31%→7.5% and JNJ 7.72%→7.5% are haircut exactly as their verdicts asked rather than exited, AMZN is held flat at 8.0%, and LLY is added 5.85%→8.0% into RSI 28.8 on the cohort's other best entry (quality 6) but capped there because its 0.515 range/price is the widest in the batch; the four new names (JPM, AAPL, META, UNP) are additions funded by the mandate-driven index/ballast reduction, not displacements. The megacap-tech/AI cluster totals 42.5% direct (NVDA 13.0 + MSFT 8.5 + AMZN 8.0 + AAPL 6.5 + META 6.5), inside the 48% cap with ~2.5pp more look-through inside the 6.0% SPY residual; the DEFENSIVE total is 8.0% and is JNJ alone (7.5% direct + ~0.5pp inside SPY) — LLY's 0.515 range/price fails the 0.42 vol gate, and there is no staples, utility, telecom, REIT or bullion position anywhere, which is the intended shape now that the defensive floor and gold sleeve are zero. Drops and why: SPY 17.2%→6.0% because the index core is a residual under Mandate A, not ballast (a 17% tracker is 17% that can only match the benchmark this book exists to beat); GLDM exits because the mandated diversifier sleeve is retired and bullion has no expected equity alpha here; KO exits because its slot existed solely to satisfy the now-zero 15% defensive floor; GOOGL, BKNG and MA are out because none reached this cycle's verified survivor set, so no current research supports their weight — the two-strike phase-out retains all of them at prior weight for one more cycle, so nothing is sold on absence this week; VTI leaves the target as the parking vehicle, which is exempt from off-target exits and so is not a forced sale. | risk-adjusted (finalize-target.mjs: correlation-cluster + vol-scaled caps) — megacap-tech cluster trimmed 1.5pp to its 48% cap — 49.5% direct + 3.8% via index look-through (NVDA/MSFT/AMZN/AAPL/META/GOOGL); megacap-tech is 48.0% direct (within its 48% cap) but 51.8% including 3.8pp held inside index vehicles — reported, not enforced | phase-out retained (churn governor, strike 1): GOOGL, KO, VTI, GLDM, MA, BKNG | 3.8% gold diversifier added structurally AFTER synthesis (mandate sleeve — the sleeves cannot score bullion), so percentages quoted in the summary above predate it; the defensive/diversifier/cluster fields are authoritative | entry bands measured against the COHORT MEDIAN entryQuality 3.5 (Mandate A: a name is tightened for being a worse entry than its peers, never for the tape as a whole being rich)
